verdict.rationale: cubic offers several first-party programmatic surfaces. Its MCP server lets agents read review findings, request PR reviews and triage PR or codebase-scan issues, and it now also handles subscriptions, seats and roles. There is also an Analytics API with PR-level data and a CLI for local reviews. However, nothing documents a general-purpose API matching the UI, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented general REST API with parity to UI actions (custom agents, auto-approval, Fix with cubic, wiki, cross-repo linking, integrations settings), a published OpenAPI spec, and an explicit API-parity claim or independent corroboration.
